feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. The candidate is the iteration 5 design (score 75.779, the best raced so far: kp 2.0, ki 0.3, kd 0.1, search_right, sensors at x = -0.04, -0.015, 0, 0.015, 0.04 with 12 mm footprint) with one change: base_speed from 1.0 to 1.1. Iterations 6, 7 and 8 each moved one field away from that design and each lost score (kp 1.6 gave 51.18, sensor_size 0.016 gave 60.12, kd 0.2 gave 69.03), so the iteration 5 gains and sensing stay. Iterations 2 and 3 are the only clean speed comparison: they share sensors and gains and differ only in base_speed (1.3 vs 1.0). Lowering speed raised oval progress (0.115 to 0.209) and lowered s-bend (0.150 to 0.126) and slalom (0.105 to 0.084) progress. So speed trades progress between the oval and the bend tracks. The candidate therefore may gain on the bends and lose on the oval, and the rationale's expectation that the oval holds near 0.29 is not guaranteed by that trade-off. Every raced run has ended with one line-loss event and max_error of about 0.061 to 0.067 m, above the 0.06 m limit, with low oscillation, so the robot drifts to an edge rather than weaving. The candidate is valid and a single-variable step from the best design, and there are only two iterations left after this one, so approving it for the race is the better use of the remaining runs. Read the race this way. (1) If the bend tracks rise and the oval loses little, and the score beats 75.779, keep base_speed 1.1 and try 1.2 next. (2) If the oval falls clearly and the score drops below 75.779, revert base_speed to 1.0, which is the iteration 5 best. (3) If progress is unchanged on every track, speed is not the limiter at this range, and the remaining lever is base_speed only if a later iteration has spare runs.
requested_changes: Race as written. If progress rises on the s-bend and slalom and the score exceeds 75.779, keep base_speed 1.1 and test base_speed 1.2 next, with kp 2.0, ki 0.3, kd 0.1 and search_right.
If the oval progress falls clearly below about 0.27 or the score falls below 75.779, revert base_speed to 1.0 (iteration 5, 75.779). Do not change any other field in the same revision.
If progress is unchanged on all tracks, leave the iteration 5 design as the best gain set and do not spend further runs on speed alone.
